notes_for_editor: Only two sources cover the tower's history: the register (build year, removal year 1981, registration date) and the Forest Lookouts page (1930 construction, 1939 observer). The 80-foot height is the planned height reported in 1930; no source gives the height of the finished tower, so facts.height_m is the planned figure. The removal year rests on the register alone. No source describes the site today or its public access, so access is omitted and the story says so. The Mapcarta point is an OpenStreetMap-based map entry with no status and is not evidence that anything stands there. The brief's coordinates and elevation (751 m) match the register. Forest Lookouts' 1930 article spells the village 'Elistie'; the story uses the register's spelling. No photos with URLs and licences were found. No fire history found; topic left out.
